scope: Official Bend 2.0.37 full-worker build and bounded correctness validation. No full region, game launch or throughput benchmark.

compiler.limits: JSC concurrency/heap heuristic, not CPU affinity or a hard RSS cap.

native.scope:
Build the stock Bend worker in separately bounded emission/native/Metal stages.

Native mode emits the complete engine, compiles one binary at reduced priority,
and checks CPU protocol startup/shutdown. Metal mode copies that binary into a
new output directory and asks its stock runtime to build its matching archive.
Emit mode saves C without native compilation. Compile mode accepts that saved C
without re-emitting the worker. No mode generates terrain, installs a worker,
or launches Minecraft.
limitations: Build and protocol smoke only; no terrain correctness or performance claim.
Metal archive construction does not prove device execution.
No installation or packaging is performed.

result.scope:
Compare Bend's brick lighting to an independent scalar flood fill.

Uses actual exported Minecraft optics and paired face coverage. Tests both light
channels, opaque emitters, fluids/leaves, partial shapes, isolated cavities,
brick boundaries and virtual top/bottom sections. No MCA/whole-region claim.

limitations: Small fixture correctness only; no full region or speedup claim.
CPU execution only; GPU behavior unverified.
